title: Inkheart
author: Cornelia Funke
summary: Twelve-year-old Meggie learns that her father can read characters out of books into the real world, and a ruthless villain who escaped one wants to use the gift for his own ends.
readIf: you love stories about books and the characters inside them.
skipIf: you want a fast, light read, as this one is long and fairly intricate.
